title: Two & Three Dimensional Models
description: Area of 2D shapes; volume and surface area of prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones, and spheres; cross sections, nets, and solids made by spinning a shape.

practice.prompt: A triangle has a base of 12 cm and a height of 7 cm. Find its area in cm².

figure.alt: A triangle with base 12 cm and height 7 cm. The height meets the base at a right angle.

hints: A triangle is half of a rectangle: A = ½ · b · h.
b = 12 and h = 7.
12 · 7 = 84. Now take half.

practice.prompt: A trapezoid has bases of 8 m and 14 m and a height of 5 m. Find its area in m².

figure.alt: Trapezoid with bases 14 m and 8 m and height 5 m.

hints: Trapezoid area: A = ½ (b₁ + b₂) · h.
Add the bases first: 8 + 14 = 22.

practice.prompt: A rectangular prism (box) is 4 in by 5 in by 6 in. Find its volume in in³.

figure.alt: Rectangular box 4 in by 5 in by 6 in.

hints: Volume of a prism = (area of the base) × height.
For a box that is length × width × height.

practice.prompt: A cylinder has radius 3 and height 10. Find its volume. Give the answer in terms of π or round to the hundredths place.
hints: Cylinder: V = (area of the circle base) × height = πr²h.
Base area = π · 3² = 9π.
Multiply by the height, 10.

practice.prompt: A cone has radius 6 and height 8. Find its volume. Give the answer in terms of π or round to the hundredths place.
hints: A cone is ⅓ of a cylinder with the same base and height: V = ⅓ πr²h.
Take one third of 288π.

practice.prompt: A square pyramid has a base side of 9 and a height of 10. Find its volume.

figure.alt: Square pyramid with base side 9 and height 10.

hints: Pyramid: V = ⅓ · B · h, where B is the area of the base.
The base is a square, so B = 9² = 81.

practice.prompt: A sphere has radius 3. Find its volume. Give the answer in terms of π or round to the hundredths place.
hints: Sphere: V = (4/3) πr³.

practice.prompt: Find the total surface area of a cube with edge length 5.
hints: Surface area means the total area of all the faces.
A cube has 6 square faces, each 5 × 5.
practice.solution: Each face: 5² = 25. Six faces: 6 · 25 = 150 square units

practice.prompt: A cone and a cylinder have the same radius and the same height. The cone's volume is what fraction of the cylinder's?

figure.alt: A cone and a cylinder with the same radius and the same height.

hints: Compare the formulas: cylinder V = πr²h, cone V = ⅓ πr²h.
What number is in front of the cone formula?
It takes three full cones of water to fill the matching cylinder.
practice.solution: Cone: ⅓ πr²h. Cylinder: πr²h. The cone is 1/3 of the cylinder.

practice.prompt: A closed cylinder has radius 2 and height 5. Find its total surface area. Give the answer in terms of π or round to the hundredths place.

figure.alt: Closed cylinder with radius 2 and height 5. Both bases are shown.

hints: Think of the parts: two circles (top and bottom) plus the side, which unrolls into a rectangle.
Two circles: 2πr² = 2π(4) = 8π. Side: 2πr · h = 2π(2)(5).
Add 8π and 20π.

practice.prompt: A cylinder is sliced straight down through the center of both circles, perpendicular to the bases. What shape is the cross section?
hints: A cross section is the flat face you would see after cutting the solid.
The cut goes from the top circle straight down to the bottom circle.
Its width is the diameter, and its height is the height of the cylinder.
practice.solution: The cut runs across a diameter and down the full height, so the face is a rectangle (diameter × height). A cut parallel to the bases would give a circle.

practice.prompt: This net is one square with four matching triangles attached to its sides. Folded up, what solid does it make?

figure.alt: A net made of one square in the middle with a triangle attached to each of its four sides.

hints: A net is a flat pattern that folds into a solid.
The square will be the base. Fold each triangle up.
The four triangle tips meet at one point at the top.
practice.solution: One square base plus four triangles that meet at a point: a square pyramid.

flashcards.back: A = ½ · b · h (height is perpendicular to the base)

figure.alt: Triangle with base b and height h perpendicular to the base.

flashcards.front: Volume of a prism or cylinder
flashcards.back: V = B · h (B = area of the base). Cylinder: V = πr²h

flashcards.front: Volume of a pyramid or cone
flashcards.back: V = ⅓ · B · h. Cone: V = ⅓ πr²h
Length: cm. Area: cm² (square units). Volume: cm³ (cubic units).
If two solids have the same height and the same cross-section area at every level, they have the same volume.
Surface area is multiplied by k²; volume is multiplied by k³.

flashcards.front: Cross sections, nets, and solids of revolution
flashcards.back: Cross section: the flat shape you get by slicing a solid. Net: a flat pattern that folds into a solid. Solid of revolution: spin a 2D shape around a line (a rectangle makes a cylinder, a right triangle makes a cone).

quiz.prompt: A parallelogram has a base of 11 and a height of 6. Find its area.
hints: A = b · h.

quiz.prompt: A cylinder has a diameter of 8 and a height of 5. Find its volume. Give the answer in terms of π or round to the hundredths place.
hints: Use the radius: r = 8 ÷ 2 = 4.
V = πr²h.

quiz.prompt: A cone has radius 3 and height 7. Find its volume. Give the answer in terms of π or round to the hundredths place.
hints: V = ⅓ πr²h.

quiz.prompt: A pyramid has a rectangular base 6 by 4 and a height of 9. Find its volume.
hints: V = ⅓ · B · h.

quiz.prompt: Find the surface area of a sphere with radius 6. Give the answer in terms of π or round to the hundredths place.
hints: SA = 4πr².

quiz.prompt: If you double every dimension of a box (length, width, and height), its volume is multiplied by:
hints: Volume = l · w · h, and each one doubles.
quiz.solution: (2l)(2w)(2h) = 8 · lwh. Volume is multiplied by 8 (k³ with k = 2).

quiz.prompt: A right triangle with legs 3 and 4 is spun all the way around the leg of length 4. What solid does it sweep out?

figure.alt: A right triangle with a vertical leg of 4 and a horizontal leg of 3. A dashed line runs along the vertical leg as the spin axis.

hints: The leg of length 4 stays still and becomes the height.
The leg of length 3 sweeps out a circle: the base.
quiz.solution: A circular base (radius 3) and a point at the top (height 4): a cone.
